messages:
sara: Quick ask — we need to lock the cut date for 3.5.0. Current candidate: Wed May 24 22:00 UTC. Need canary owners, rollback liaisons, and escrow contacts. Can folks confirm availability and nominate backups? Also pasting a short agenda template below.

tom: I’m out Wed afternoon but 22:00 UTC works. Can take canary owner if nobody else picks it. :+1:

james: 22:00 works for me too. Suggest we add a 'dependency migration check' (3m) into the agenda.

anika: I can own rollback diagnostics and the post-cut smoke checklist. cc @chris for infra readiness.

chris: Oncall window is clear for that slot. I’ll be infra liaison and can run the infra smoke steps. Propose we run automated canary job ~20m before cut.

sara: Thanks all — draft agenda below (copy into the calendar invite):
```
Agenda (45m):
- Quick roll call & roles (5m) — who’s primary/backups
- Canary run & metrics to watch (10m) — canary owner presents
- Cut decision checklist + rollback criteria (10m)
- Post-cut smoke & validation owners (10m)
- AOB + contingency plan (10m)
Owners: canary (tom/james), rollback (anika), infra (chris), release lead (sara)
Notes: list the runbook URL and explicit metric thresholds.
```

tom: LGTM. Please add escrow contacts for legal/security in the invite so they can jump in if needed.

james: Also attach the migration dependency matrix and the metric thresholds (error-rate < 0.5%, p95 latency < 600ms).

deploy-bot: Reminder: submit final canary job definition and runbook link by 2165006000 (upload deadline) or the job won't be scheduled.

anika: I’ll upload the runbook and rollback checklist in ~45m and ping this thread with the link.

sara: Perfect — I’ll draft the calendar invite for Wed May 24 22:00 UTC, include the agenda + runbook link + escrow contacts (legal@redwood.example, security@redwood.example) and mark tom/james as canary owners. If anyone can’t make it, reply here and we’ll find a backup slot. :calendar: :white_check_mark:

chris: Thanks — I’ll queue the infra smoke script to run 20m before cut and share logs in the #incidents channel during the window.

sara: Invite created: https://calendar.redwood.example/event/3.5-cut-2165004321 — added runbook and rollback checklist. Ping if anything changes.
